correctness.rationale: The four-marked-vertex involution counting scheme with 43 partial patterns yields one-point descent probability (n^2-k^2)/[2n(n-1)] and disjoint two-point covariance (n-k)H_n(k)/[2n^2(n-3)(n-2)(n-1)^2]. The sign polynomial H_n is strictly decreasing: H_n structure and the negative discriminant of H_n' secure a unique root between 0 and n; k=n is deterministic zero. Expanding its cubic at n=t^3 yields leading k=2^(-1/3)t^2 plus the specified -2^(1/3)t/6 and 1/6 corrections. Independent direct exact involution enumeration for n=4..8 verified 151 feasible nonoverlapping covariance cases; these examples do not replace the symbolic marked-pattern counting proof.
